page.notes: The first line of the page continues a paragraph from the previous page, so it is marked cont="true". "Syllloges" is printed with three l's and is copied as printed; it may be a printing error for "Sylloges". "Vsferij" is copied as printed. The mark before "Addo" in the italic passage is a printed symbol, not a letter; it is left out. The word "hîc" is copied as "hic". The word broken at the line end, "alia-" / "rum", is joined as "aliarum" in the text where it is printed across the line break, with the printed hyphen kept at the break.
